name: Triplenerdscore
headline: Astro websites built for search engines and AI answers, delivered as an ongoing engineering partner
overview: Triplenerdscore works with Techlio as an ongoing engineering partner for websites built on Astro. Techlio builds and redesigns the sites from supplied designs, and handles the technical SEO and answer engine optimisation (AEO) that makes them easy for Google and AI assistants to read and cite.
architecture: Each site is built on Astro, which ships pages as plain HTML with very little JavaScript, so they load quickly and are easy for crawlers to read. Structured data, clean URLs, sitemaps and answer-first content are built in from the start.
